text:
Aisha: Quick heads up — customer reported confusing SDK error when app hits burst limit. It just says "quota exceeded" with no retry info. Can we standardize?

Tom: Seen this. SDK basically forwards whatever API 429 body comes back. Some endpoints give "quota exceeded", others include retry_after. Super inconsistent across SDKs.

Priya: Agreed. My recommendation: canonical error schema with both human and machine fields. Machine fields: code, throttle_type, retry_after_ms. Human: message. Example payload we should standardize on:
```json
{
  "error": "TooManyRequests",
  "code": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
  "throttle_type": "burst",
  "retry_after_ms": 1200,
  "message": "Request rate exceeded. Try again in 1.2s or use batched calls for high throughput."
}
```

Tom: +1. Also we should normalize codes to these buckets: KEY_RATE_LIMIT, ORG_RATE_LIMIT, BURST_LIMIT. SDKs can switch logic based on code instead of parsing text.

santiago: Add standard headers too: Retry-After (seconds) for http clients, and X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining, X-Redwood-Quota-Reset. That helps console and proxies.

Priya: Console UX: show a small banner on the request detail with the human message and a CTA (docs / enable-dedicated / contact support). For burst limits show a countdown if retry_after_ms present. Also add a short help panel explaining per-key vs per-org.

Aisha: Who owns the SDK change? devex or platform? @devex? :thinking:

Tom: I can take SDK changes (JS + Python). I'll add the schema negotiation and mapping in the client layer so apps get consistent exceptions. Will also include retry_after_ms in exception object.

rate-limiter-bot: Blocked request org:org-9876 key:key-abc reason=burst_exceeded wait_ms=1800

Priya: Also include a recommended client backoff snippet in docs: exponential backoff with jitter, start 200ms, cap 10s. Small sample for JS and Python.
```js
// pseudo-code
await retryWithBackoff(async () => callRedwood(), { base: 200, cap: 10000, jitter: true });
```

Tom: Plan: API change — always return code + retry_after_ms by EOW. SDK PRs next week. Console banner prototype in PR #1426. I'll add telemetry tag `quota.exposed_v1` so we can measure adoption.

Aisha: Perfect. Please add a short note in release notes and a docs section titled "Handling rate limits and retries". Also create a small experiment to see if clearer messages reduce support tickets.

santiago: One nuance: for Dedicated customers we might return a friendlier message that points to their SLA contact rather than generic quota docs. We should handle that in the routing layer.

Tom: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/459 — includes schema proposal, header list, and SDK checklist.

Priya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
